command:
set -eu
printf 'NODE=%s IP=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf '%s\n' '== os =='
cat /etc/os-release
uname -r
printf '%s\n' '== package/service managers =='
command -v dnf || true
command -v yum || true
command -v systemctl || true
rpm -q bash coreutils util-linux 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '== filesystems =='
findmnt -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS /
findmnt -T /srv/data -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS 2>/dev/null || true
lsblk -f
printf '%s\n' '== lvm/btrfs snapshot capability =='
command -v lvs >/dev/null && lvs -a -o lv_name,vg_name,lv_attr,lv_size,data_percent,origin || true
command -v btrfs >/dev/null && btrfs filesystem show 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '== data metadata and digest =='
if [ -e /srv/data ]; then stat -c '%A %a %U:%G %n' /srv /srv/data; find /srv/data -xdev -printf '%y %m %u:%g %s %p\n' | sort; find /srv/data -xdev -type f -exec sha256sum {} + | sort -k2; else printf '%s\n' '/srv/data absent'; fi
printf '%s\n' '== failed services/listeners =='
systemctl --failed --no-pager 2>/dev/null || true
ss -lntup 2>/dev/null || true
